title: dispatch_queue.py --only <id> still loads, validates and plans all ~2,109 queue units, filtering only at the decision loop (scripts/research/dispatch_queue.py:1707). A single-unit dry run takes 71 s locally (MEASURED 2026-11-12 17:55Z, origin/main bc48d181), so tests/test_research_queue.py::test_w4_dispatcher_dry_run_selects_the_unit (subprocess timeout=120 at line 356) times out on slow runners: 6 pytest-run failures on #25312 (run 43263773705), 892 s run. It worsens as the queue grows. Fix: apply --only before the per-job planning, without changing --fire semantics, so a single-unit dry run is sub-second. Done when that test runs under 10 s locally and pytest-run on main has no TimeoutExpired from it. Gates: none.
